thread:
ali: Observed p95 tail increase for short streams after recent kernel tweaks. Host-side parse & write path seems to be the culprit.
rene: saw the alert. can you drop a short flame?
ali: paste:
```
flame: http_ingress -> parse_frames -> utf8_full_normalize -> write_consolidator.flush_small -> grpc_write -> epoll_wait
hotspots: write_consolidator.flush_small (44%), utf8_full_normalize (21%), grpc_write (12%)
```
sophia: That 'write_consolidator.flush_small' is triggering many small syscalls per chunk. Kernel speed wins, but host syscall overhead now dominates for <=80-token responses.
matt: Two low-risk mitigations: 1) reintroduce a short-window write consolidation that coalesces adjacent small frames into a single write (configurable bytes/count/timeout); 2) add a utf8 "sketch-check" fast-path to skip full normalization when input is already NFC.
ali: quick bench: enabling consolidation (max_bytes=3500, max_frames=3, window_ms=7) + utf8 sketch-check dropped p95 from 198ms -> 142ms on our short-stream microbench. syscalls per request down ~3.6x. CPU on proxy +5%.
rene: what's the KV impact? holding frames could increase leader serialization on kvcache misses for big multi-frame requests.
sophia: checked kvcache traces: typical single-frame or two-frame requests unaffected. large multi-frame clients (20+ frames) saw ~6% kv latency bump during initial canary.
matt: propose safe defaults and bypass rules: default consolidation enabled; bypass if frame_count>9 OR body_size>96KB OR tenant.opt_out=true. For miss-paths, tighten to bypass when frame_count>5. Also add a per-tenant override to disable consolidation for heavy streamers.
ali: added lightweight sketch-check: scan for non-ascii combining marks and a few common byte patterns; false-positive rate in bench <0.6%. Using that to avoid utf8 normalize for most payloads.
rene: telemetry please: counters histograms "host.write_consolidator.write_calls", "host.parse.utf8_sketch_ms", "host.write_consolidator.held_bytes", and taggable counter "host.write_consolidator.bypass_reason".
sophia: pushed branch and kicked a 5% canary to intake-1. ops-bot?
ops-bot: deploy streamer/burst-coalesce v1.2 -> intake-1 (5%)
ops-bot: rollout started
ali: 15m canary snapshot: p95 -24% on short streams, write_calls per-request -3.7x, utf8_sketch_ms median 0.07ms. One heavy tenant showed kv latency +6%.
matt: tightened miss-path bypass to frame_count>4 and added tenant opt-out flag. pushed update and expanded canary to 20%.
ops-bot: rollout update: intake-1 canary -> 20%
sophia: post-update: heavy tenant kv latency back to baseline; overall p95 -20%. CPU delta acceptable.
rene: PR checklist: include microbench harness, flame outputs, the consolidation knobs (host.write_consolidator.max_bytes, max_frames, window_ms), utf8_sketch flag, miss-path bypass threshold, and per-tenant opt-out. Also add a note to the kernel rollout playbook: short-seq kernel flips must include host write-consolidation validation.
ali: scheduling 25m sync tomorrow to pick defaults and prod rollout cadence. labels: perf, host-parse, grpc, kvcache.
